safetyRules: Do not mark a human five score as an actual app image publication, image rights or crop approval
The score protects the image the user actually rated; if the card photo does not represent the nominal original, do not transfer the five to another painting
Displaced nominal feasts are not principal observances; only resolved commemorations link to the date as commemoration
Composite feasts' single-saint images are component context, not a complete group feast representation
A name-only match is a relationship lead, not canonical saint identity certification; source-date guards protect ambiguities
Older subject cards rated five 'elsewhere' do not count as an appropriate image for the same saint
SUITABLE_ELSEWHERE is an explicit placement exclusion for the reviewed saint, even if the same physical original was aesthetically rated 5/5.
